title: akundisco
features:
Anti-Hit — 
A script feature that tries to prevent or hide incoming damage to your character so hits are not registered or do less effect

Anti-AFK — Fakes activity so the server doesn’t kick you for being idle.

ESP (Extra Sensory Perception) — Shows player or item locations through walls or on the map.

Teleport / TP — Instantly moves your character to coordinates or another player.

NoClip / Walk Through — Lets you pass through objects and walls.

Speedhack / WalkSpeed Change — Alters walking or running speed beyond normal limits.

Fly / Hover — Allows flying or hovering above the ground.

Auto-Farm / Auto-Collect — Automatically gathers resources, coins, or items.

Auto-Quest / Auto-Complete — Automatically completes quests or tasks to get rewards.

Auto-Heal / Regen — Automatically restores health or reduces damage effects.

Desync / Netless — Creates a mismatch between your client state and the server to avoid some interactions.

Server Hop — Moves you between servers (often to find better spawns or avoid problems).

Anti-Detection / Obfuscation — Techniques that try to hide the script’s actions from anti-cheat systems.

Auto-Equip / Item Manager — Automatically equips weapons or items based on conditions.

Logging / Notifications — Records events or shows alerts about players, loot, or script actions.
